title: Plan review — activity-aware guided-chat recommendations
intro: Opus 5.5 high inspected the guided-chat code and prepared the detailed temporary plan in PLAN.md. No Pictures code or tests were changed or run. These answers confirm or adjust the product choices before implementation; use the recommended option where you want Opus's proposal.
coverage: 7/10 topics clear; remaining product choices in this round

questions.text: What should define the event-to-structure recommendations? Choosing the curated option accepts or lets you edit the complete table in PLAN.md.

options.label: Use Opus's curated table; library coverage is evidence only
Derive recommendations only from existing visible library ideas
Use a custom mapping; describe edits in the note

questions.why: The 31 visible ideas cover only 10 of 18 official structures, with especially thin coverage for bautizo, Navidad, and empresa.

options.label: Only on the existing Propónme algo path; no new chat step
Add a proactive recommendation step after the event is known
Both the existing path and a new proactive step

questions.why: This adds activity relevance to the current flow without inserting a new turn that competes with the idea carousel.

questions.text: What counts as an independent part of a decoration?

options.label: One official structure chosen through the existing individual-piece path
A component extracted from an existing library decoration

questions.why: The existing individual path already supports official structures; library ideas do not carry per-piece material breakdowns.

questions.text: How should unsupported 3D structures and unknown activities behave?

options.label: Never recommend no-3D structures; keep explicit requests and current unknown-event behavior
Exclude no-3D structures from every free recommendation, including unknown events; keep explicit requests
Allow no-3D structures when they fit the activity and keep current fallback handling

questions.why: Customers can still request a structure explicitly; unsupported structures should not be proactively recommended, and unknown activities should not regress.

questions.text: How should the individual-piece menu present event recommendations?

options.label: Keep the existing cards and only reorder matching exact IDs; no badge or new cards
Show the exact event-specific official structures as selectable cards, plus «La que tú quieras»
Reorder existing cards and mark recommended ones

questions.why: Some IDs at the top of Opus's mapping have no current menu card; displaying their exact IDs lets the customer select the actual recommendation.
